程序包 org.bukkit.event.player

类 PlayerFishEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerFishEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class PlayerFishEvent extends PlayerEvent implements Cancellable
当玩家钓鱼时触发本事件.

原文： Thrown when a player is fishing

If you want to monitor a fishhooks state transition, you can use FishHookStateChangeEvent.

    • getCaught

      @Nullable public @Nullable Entity getCaught()
      获取玩家钓到的实体.

      原文： Gets the entity caught by the player.

      If player has fished successfully, the result may be cast to Item.

      返回:
      玩家钓到的实体, 钓鱼时为实体, 如果鱼钩卡在地面上或什么都没钓到则为 null

      原文：Entity caught by the player, Entity if fishing, and null if bobber has gotten stuck in the ground or nothing has been caught

    • getHook

      代表钓鱼钩/浮标的实体

    • getHand

      @Nullable public @Nullable EquipmentSlot getHand()
      获取此事件中使用的手.

      原文： Get the hand that was used in this event.

      The hand used is only present for player interactions. This means it will be null if state is set to PlayerFishEvent.State.BITE or PlayerFishEvent.State.FAILED_ATTEMPT.

      返回:
      使用的手

      原文：the hand

    • getExpToDrop

      public int getExpToDrop()
      获取钓鱼时获得的经验值.

      原文： Gets the amount of experience received when fishing.

      Note: This value has no default effect unless the event state is PlayerFishEvent.State.CAUGHT_FISH.

      返回:
      掉落的经验值数量

      原文：the amount of experience to drop
